name: jira_search
description: Searches the Jira issues of the projects assigned to this assistant with a JQL query, newest matches as Jira orders them. Use it when the user asks which issues exist, what is assigned to someone, what is open or blocked, or needs an issue key they do not know. It does not show an issue's description or comments (that is jira_issue with the key) and changes nothing. The query is always limited to the assigned projects. Returns a count line, then one line per issue: KEY | status | type | assignee | summary.

jql.description: JQL filter as the user described it, without the project (e.g. status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC).

limit.description: How many issues to show at most (e.g. 20).

examples.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
